title: On Mentioning the money only once
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：mention　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mention 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the engineer ① mentioned the money only once year after year, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the engineer ② mentions the money only once for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ mention the money only once at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ mentioned the money only once before — a line in the manual for April 1948 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Mentioning the money only once year after year, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ mention the plan to nobody else for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Mention the plan to nobody else at once and never mention it again.

By 1961 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manual, and a new worker from the next workshop ⑧ mentions the plan to nobody else year after year every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ mentioned the money only once again when nobody else would.

⑩ To mention the money only once, my mother said in 1966, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody mentions the money only once for the whole place again and somebody must mention the money only once year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 提到（一般过去式 mentioned the money only once：1954 年工程师头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 提到（一般现在 mentions the money only once：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 提到（不定式 to mention the money only once：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 提到（过去完成时 had mentioned the money only once：1948 年四月的说明书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 提到（动名词 mentioning the money only once 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 说及（mention the plan to nobody else：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去说及再没把方案对别人说起）
G. v. 说及（mention the plan to nobody else：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 提到（后段两处：新来的工人照例 mentions the plan to nobody else，而母亲又一次 mentioned the money only once）

items.q: to mention the money only once
mentioned the money only once before
mention the plan to nobody else for the whole place
mention the plan to nobody else at once
mentions the plan to nobody else year after year
mentioned the money only once again
to mention the money only once

answers.why: mention 意为“提到”，1954 年工程师年年地提到只提过一次钱的事，那是车间里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 mentioned。
mention 意为“提到”，自那以后工程师替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 mentions。
mention 意为“提到”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯提到只提过一次钱的事”，此处为不定式 to mention the money only once。
mention 意为“提到”，说明书里 四月 那行字说明早在 1961 年之前就有人提到过，故用过去完成时 had mentioned。
mention 意为“提到”，工程师说“提到只提过一次钱的事这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 mentioning the money only once 作主语。
mention 意为“说及”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去说及再没把方案对别人说起”，should ever 之后用原形 mention the plan to nobody else。
mention 意为“说及”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻说及再没把方案对别人说起（mention the plan to nobody else at once），以后再也不要提起。
mention 意为“提到”，新来的工人每个年头都照例说及再没把方案对别人说起，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 mentions。
mention 意为“提到”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地提到只提过一次钱的事，用一般过去式 mentioned 叙述。
mention 意为“提到”，结尾那句是母亲 1966 年的话：要提到只提过一次钱的事，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车间记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，工程师年年地提到只提过一次钱的事；车间里每一个工人都说这是头一回。（mentioned the money only once）
多年以后，工程师仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（mentions the money only once）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯提到只提过一次钱的事这件事本身。（to mention the money only once）
早在 1948 年就有人提到只提过一次钱的事，四月那天说明书上的一行字就是证据。（had mentioned the money only once）
工程师说过，年年地提到只提过一次钱的事这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（mentioning the money only once 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻说及再没把方案对别人说起，以后再也不要提起。（mention the plan to nobody else，祈使句）
answers: In 1954 the engineer mentioned the money only once year after year, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the engineer still mentions the money only once for the whole place without being asked.
My mother said later that to mention the money only once at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had mentioned the money only once long before 1961, and the line in the manual for April proves it.
Mentioning the money only once year after year, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Mention the plan to nobody else at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 mention 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the engineer mentioned the money only once year after year, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the engineer mentions the money only once for the whole place whenever the workshop asks.
Mentioning the money only once year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever mention the plan to nobody else for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next workshop mentions the plan to nobody else year after year every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother mentioned the money only once again, and the workshop remembered that half.
